description: Hand-picked inputs for the rink-plane calibration of the match recording (scripts/game-calibrate.py). Image positions are crop px of the stabilised working image (game_common.py). Picked by Claude on 2026-10-07 from 3x zooms of the median background; uncertainty about 2-3 crop px for slot ends, about 0.5 crop px for the lines (Hough fits).

orientation.statement: World -x (goal.W) is the video's left end and world +y is the far long side.
orientation.reason: The rink markings and slot layout are point-symmetric (a 180 deg turn maps each team's slots onto the other's), so the video alone cannot tell goal.W from goal.E. Choosing goal.W at the left makes team W the team of the left player (Fylling, user answer A1).

slot_end_anchors.note: far slot with the hook at the left end
end of the straight part along the right end board

lines.method: Hough segment on the dark-pixel mask of the background
Hough segment on the dark-pixel mask of the background

slot_chamfer.statement: Every skater slot centreline (data/geometry.json, status assumed) sampled every 3 mm must lie on dark pixels of the background (distance transform, truncated at 3 crop px). Goalie slots are left out: the goalies stand on them in the median background.
slot_chamfer.dark_pixel_rule: HSV value < 110 and saturation < 120 on the 4x upscaled background

initial_estimate: First fit through the anchors above plus the two goalie slot ends of W-G and E-G (dropped from the final fit: in the background the goalie figures cover them).
